Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : 1) Valid Trade Licence -Current.
2) Valid VAT Registration Certificate
3) Valid TIN Certificate (Up-to-date) and acknowledgement receipt
4) In order to proof the Tenderers Financial capability necessary to perform the contract the Tenderer shall furnish the average
annual turnover (at least 2.0 core) over theÂ last five (05) years.
5) The Tenderer must have at least 15 years experience. (In place of existing)
6) Provide Minimum 2 Satisfactory Completion Certificate of Supply of LED /Electric goods from the government/semi government
organization in last five (05) years.
7) The tenderer must have the track record of honoring a single Contract of min Taka 3 crores on LED Display or similar electrical
goods in last 3 years.
8) The bidder/tenderer should have the Bank solvency of min 3 crore Taka
9) The Exporter/Manufacturer must have experience in LED business of min 10 years
10) In case of Limited Company, the certificate of Incorporation or Registration of Firm;
11) List of 5 organizations (Govt./ Non-Govt.) where similar projects (Electrical goods /LED Display project is preferable) done by
the company mentioning with client name, duration of project completion, total manpower involvement (enclose work
order/contract agreement) Min value of each contract Taka 1.5 crore for last three years.
12) List of at least 05 (Five) Clients of the manufacturer/dealer that the manufacturer/dealer has provided the same brand.
13) The original money receipt/challan issued by the authority as an evidence of purchase the Tender Documents by the Tenderer.
14) The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 5 crore.
15) The manufacturer must have ISO9001:2008,
16) The products (LED) must have CE, ROHS, CCC certificates.
